description.value: BridgeDeck Kitchen & Taps is the Lonsdale Avenue restaurant and taproom of North Vancouver's Bridge Brewing Co., pairing the brewery's full craft beer lineup with a food menu in a full-service sit-down setting. Located on a main North Shore cycling artery, it offers both indoor and outdoor seating. It is one of three Bridge Brewing locations on the North Shore.
